kind_label: AI assistants, agents, answer engines, AI notes

hands.name: Typographic Writing Surface

signature.typography: The type is the interface. A custom geometric-humanist sans with about 1.6 line height and hybrid Markdown that keeps faint ** markers visible beside rendered bold (bear); a per-document serif or sans style (craft); a user choice of SF, a book serif or mono (tot).
signature.color: One theme accent for links, cursor and headings (bear red #dd4c4f on light, green on charcoal, amber); user-chosen document backdrops and page tints (craft); seven fixed dot colours each repainting its page (tot). Chrome otherwise grey or near-white.
signature.shape: A rounded page card about 20pt floating on a backdrop with concentric inner radii (craft); otherwise few drawn shapes: about 8-10pt tag pills, capsule and circle floating controls.
signature.density: Low: one note per screen, wide 28-30pt side margins.
signature.navigation: Chrome shrinks to floating capsules: a back circle and an info/more capsule (bear), a glass back circle, share capsule and a 3-icon glass capsule tab bar (craft), or seven coloured rings as the entire navigation with no tab bar (tot).
signature.imagery: None beyond the user's own covers (craft) and thin outline icons.

hands.corpus_warning: Warning: flag persistent formatting toolbars, tab bars or feature chrome that compete with the page. Advanced features stay hidden until invoked (text-sourced from bear).

axes.shell: quiet: chrome recedes until asked for
axes.posture: native iOS: system bars, sheets, gestures and glass come from the platform
axes.material: Liquid Glass is chrome only: system tab bar, toolbars and sheets. It is never the identity.

hands.governing_asset: the page itself as the interface, with 28-30 pt margins
hands.display_treatment: a face the user chooses per document

hands.name: Dark Pro Minimal

signature.typography: A neutral grotesque with grey sentence-case section labels and no display flourish (Inter-like in linear, SF in raycast, an FK-Grotesk-like face plus mono metadata numerals in perplexity).
signature.color: Dark surfaces stepped by lightness rather than shadow (linear app #18181a with chips on #1c1c1e/#2b2b2b; raycast #0f0f0f; perplexity #1a1a1a; coinbase-wallet navy #0a0f15; phantom pure black). Colour semantic only (health green/yellow/red). One reserved accent: linear periwinkle #7b80f0 for the swipe action, perplexity turquoise #20b8cd, raycast red #ff3647 only on the record state, phantom pastel lavender.
signature.shape: Capsules for every control (linear), 44pt circular header buttons (raycast), about 12pt cards; borders and lightness steps instead of shadows.
signature.density: Medium to high: single-line rows of about 56pt.
signature.navigation: Dark glass capsules: a custom floating 4-icon tab bar with a detached circular create button and grouped top-right capsules (linear, bespoke glass); circular glass header buttons and a floating composer (raycast, native glass). No visible refraction over text.
signature.imagery: Thin outline icons. No illustration. User-chosen emoji project icons are the only colour in linear's lists.

hands.corpus_warning: Warning: flag refraction over dense text, decorative colour, or mascots and 3D art in the shell (discord carries these and reads louder than the direction).

axes.shell: quiet: achromatic chrome with one reserved accent
axes.depth: one depth cue on the governing asset only, dropped under Reduce Motion (text-sourced: stills cannot show it)
axes.posture: native iOS: system bars, sheets, gestures and glass come from the platform
axes.material: Liquid Glass is chrome only: system tab bar, toolbars and sheets. It is never the identity.

hands.governing_asset: one reserved accent that appears on a single gesture or action and nowhere else
hero_moments: a row changing status in place
the one accented action (for example, swipe to complete)

hands.name: Literary Warm Assistant

signature.typography: A text serif carries reading: assistant replies in a book serif with the user's words in sans (claude); regular-weight serif note titles at about 28-32pt over a sans for UI (granola); one warm serif for both speakers (pi).
signature.color: Warm paper ground (claude cream #f8f7f3, granola warm grey #eaebe5, pi cream #faf3e9), warm-grey and near-black text, and one muted accent or none: claude terracotta #da7756 on the send button only, granola lime #b2c248 only on recording surfaces, pi forest green #1c472d line icons.
signature.shape: Flat paper; large radii (user bubbles about 16-20pt, composer a 24pt rounded rectangle in claude); 44pt circular buttons.
signature.density: Low: wide margins, large serif body, generous empty space.
signature.navigation: Reduced to top-corner circular buttons and capsules; no tab bar visible in any of the three store sets. claude's chrome is the shared chat skeleton.
signature.imagery: None in claude and granola beyond outline icons; painted illustration tiles instead of icons in pi.

hands.corpus_warning: Warning: this direction overlaps the 2026 cream-plus-serif-plus-orange default. Flag a generated brief that uses cream, serif and an orange accent together without a governing asset; require a non-orange accent or a non-cream ground, plus one structural escape from the chat skeleton.

axes.shell: quiet: paper, type and one muted accent
axes.posture: native iOS: system bars, sheets, gestures and glass come from the platform
axes.material: Liquid Glass is chrome only: system tab bar, toolbars and sheets. It is never the identity.

hands.governing_asset: a non-cream warm ground (warm grey or warm white) with serif replies
hands.display_treatment: replies in serif with the user's text in sans
hero_moments: the voice visual changing with state

motion_scheme.rule: Critically damped springs everywhere (bounce 0). On Android, the M3 Standard scheme. No overshoot on any flow that moves money, signs or deletes.

haptic_profile.rule: The mapping table in references/haptics-sound.md, with nothing on scroll, navigation or plain taps.

never_deal.name: Neutral Hyper-Minimal Assistant
never_deal.why: Never deal. Warn when a chat design reuses the skeleton and changes only the skin; require at least one structural lever (page structure or a state-encoding status visual).

never_deal.name: Feed-Grafted Assistant
never_deal.why: Never deal. meta-ai's Discover/Vibes feed is not in its store frames, so meta-ai is no longer visual evidence for this shape.

never_deal.name: Custom Glass Replica
never_deal.why: Never deal on a platform without native glass. Posture must be declared in MOBILE-DESIGN.md or checked against the view tree, because screenshots cannot assign it.
